items.quote: Wenth drove the five-year strategic plan for the division for the whole division.
Wenth championed the decision to decline vendor hospitality during a tender and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He set the direction for the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics across the public service.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of stakeholder consultations for the licensing review.
Wenth headed lean process reviews at the service centres, setting priorities for several teams.
He set the direction for keeping programme spending within the approved envelope across the public service.
Wenth championed the settlement of a long-running contract dispute and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
